build_deepsort_mot_model: build a DeepSORT multi-object tracking model with Faster R-CNN detector and SORT tracker for MOT17
configure_faster_rcnn_detector: configure a Faster R-CNN R50 FPN detector with single-class bounding box coding and pretrained MOT17 checkpoint
setup_sort_tracker: setup a SORT tracker with Kalman filter motion model, 0.5 object score threshold and 0.5 IoU match threshold
configure_track_data_preprocessor: configure TrackDataPreprocessor with BGR-to-RGB conversion and 32-pixel size divisor for multi-object tracking
setup_val_test_loops: setup validation and test loops for multi-object tracking evaluation on MOT17 half train and half val splits
